easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Glasspool Mimic
description:
Activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Rakdos Joins Up to become a creature.
Cast Glasspool Mimic by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Put Glasspool Mimic into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Glasspool Mimic's first ability and second ability trigger, along with Rakdos Joins Up's second ability.
Resolve Glasspool Mimic's second trigger and Rakdos Joins Up's trigger, dealing damage to target opponent and causing you to gain that much life.
Resolve Glasspool Mimic's first trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Repeat from step 3.
